10.1.2.4. Example HTA – CU_pm

Contexte : Un centre logistique raccorde en HTA (20 kV), option Courte Usage pointe mobile. Power souscrite 300 kW, consommation hiver et ete equilibree. Facturation de mars 2025.

from Facture.TURPE import input_Contrat, TurpeCalculator, input_Facture, input_Tarif

# Contrat HTA CU_pm — centre logistique 300 kW
contrat = input_Contrat(
    domaine_tension="HTA",
    PS_pointe=300, PS_HPH=300, PS_HCH=300, PS_HPB=300, PS_HCB=300,
    version_utilisation="CU_pm",
    pourcentage_ENR=0,
)

tarif = input_Tarif(
    c_euro_kWh_pointe=0.13,
    c_euro_kWh_HPH=0.12,
    c_euro_kWh_HCH=0.10,
    c_euro_kWh_HPB=0.11,
    c_euro_kWh_HCB=0.09,
)

# Consommation realiste (~150 MWh/mois)
facture = input_Facture(
    start="2025-03-01",
    end="2025-03-31",
    kWh_pointe=15000,
    kWh_HPH=40000,
    kWh_HCH=30000,
    kWh_HPB=35000,
    kWh_HCB=25000,
)

calc = TurpeCalculator(contrat, tarif, facture)
calc.calculate_turpe()

print(calc.df_totaux)

calc.plot()
